verdict.rationale: Extend documents schema-driven extraction ([extend-docs-10]) that returns structured output with per-field confidence scores and citations ([extend-docs-35], [extend-docs-34]), and it advertises table detection ([extend-docs-22]). One community user reports being happy with extraction accuracy ([extend-comm-1]). However, the pack only shows a page title for the schema docs and a pricing-page bullet for tables, so it does not show tables becoming typed, row-level JSON ready to load into a database. missing for 10: explicit docs on mapping tables to typed array/row schemas, field type enforcement and normalization details, DB-ready output examples, independent hands-on corroboration of clean table-to-row output.
